newsitem.title: USA: American Communications in MCI deal.
newsitem.headline: American Communications in MCI deal.

text.p: American Communications Services Inc said on Thursday MCI Communications Corp signed a non-binding letter of intent naming American Communications as its preferred local provider for dedicated access services in 21 American Communications markets for at least a five year period.

The agreement also provides for American Communications to issue MCI warrants to buy about 2.3 million shares at fair market value, including warrants to buy 620,000 shares to be issued at the signing of the definitive agreements and the remaining warrants to be issued in tranches every six months thereafter as long as the revenue generated by the agreements reaches certain levels.

MCI generally has the right to purchase additional shares of American Communicatrions common stock at a 10 percent discount to fair market value to maintain its fully diluted equity ownership, the company said.

MCI plans to migrate current dedicated access circuits in these markets to American Communications. Also, the company will be listed as the first choice provider in MCI's provisioning system for all new circuits in the designated markets, the company said.
